description.en: Aurora's Python environment, read only: Python and installed library versions, the dependencies a project declares compared with what is installed, and whether the cryptography library offers ML-KEM-768, X25519 and HKDF-SHA256. It runs a short self-test in memory and does not change anything.
description.it: L'ambiente Python di Aurora, in sola lettura: le versioni di Python e delle librerie installate, le dipendenze dichiarate da un progetto confrontate con quelle installate, e se la libreria cryptography offre ML-KEM-768, X25519 e HKDF-SHA256. Esegue una breve prova in memoria e non modifica nulla.

forged.need: Missing capability: tool `projects__project_create` to create local Python projects, tool `run_in_project` to execute code and check library versions (specifically to verify if ML-KEM-768 is available
